therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: topical antiseptic and wound healing properties
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: prevention of radiation dermatitis through antimicrobial action and tissue protection
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: women with breast cancer undergoing radiation therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: percent of women who develop grade 3 or 4 radiation dermatitis

results.effect_size: 6 out of 20 participants (30%) developed grade 3 or 4 radiation dermatitis
safety_signals: dermatitis radiation serious adverse events in 3/20 participants
results.dose_information: topical application, specific dose and schedule not specified

context.duration: baseline to up to 6 weeks after completion of radiation therapy
